capabilities: Show a local .ics calendar in month, work-week, week, day and agenda views
Create, edit, complete and delete local events
Take sketch notes with auto-save and text strikethrough
View and manage obsidian-kanban task boards on mobile
Show a home dashboard of today's schedule, sketches and open tasks
extras: Stores data in plain vault files (Calendar/Local.ics, NyaHomeData/workspace.json, Boards/*.md) so folder-sync tools can share it; the README warns against putting desktop secrets such as IMAP credentials or translation keys in the shared workspace file. Desktop and mobile versions can be installed together.
intentEvidence: NyaHome Mobile is the small-screen companion to desktop NyaHome.
motivation: Built as the small-screen companion to desktop NyaHome, without loading the desktop mail, market, reader or translation stack.
problem: Phone users have no compact way to plan a day with calendar events, quick sketches and task boards that stay in ordinary vault files.

relations.evidence: NyaHome Mobile is the small-screen companion to desktop NyaHome.
